mode_archive_hint: Mot goi gom nhom: .xapk, .apkm, .apks hoac .zip (base + cac split).
mode_splitdir_hint: Mot thu muc chua cac tep split .apk roi roi cua mot app.
scan_empty: Khong tim thay tep nao co the cai o day.

opt_spoof_hint: Dat installerPackageName de app khong trong giong sideloaded.

verifier_off_warn: De trinh xac minh tat la mot dau hieu lo stealth (mot gia tri o noi truoc do khong co). Chi dung neu ban biet tai sao.
devverif_note: Android Developer Verification duoc thuc thi boi mot dich vu rieng, khong phai Play Protect. Mot ban cai qua root von da duoc mien tru, nen cong tac nay la no-luc-toi-da.
opt_lowsdk: Bo qua chan target SDK thap
hma_text: De tang tinh an giau, hay can nhac an trinh quan ly root va cac app nhay cam cua ban bang HMA-OSS. VDInstaller khong bao gio dong vao thiet lap HMA-OSS cua ban - hay mo HMA-OSS va tu thuc hien thay doi khi ban muon.
about_what: VDInstaller cai cac APK sideload qua root khong rao can: APK don le, batch va chia nho, voi trinh xac minh Play Protect duoc xu ly thay ban va mot nguon cai dat Play tuy chon.
